baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus words are repeated active participles from س ب ق with no overt predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The forward initiative of B001 is doubled into a self-confirming class: repeated preceding is not merely something they did but what they are.

activation_trace.role: Advancing, racing, and initiating supply the literal motion and make reiterated initiative constitutive of the group's identity.

changed_reading.before: A generic label for people who happen to be earlier or ahead.
changed_reading.after: An emphatically self-defining vanguard whose identity consists in repeatedly initiating and moving ahead.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled س ب ق participle can carry both forward precedence and the root's pursuit relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: B004 changes a relative lead into failed pursuit: the first token presents outstripping, while the second can seal the result as being beyond recovery by the pursuer.

activation_trace.role: Forward movement supplies the initial comparative lead.
Escaping a seeker who cannot catch the sought turns the repeated lead into an irreversible separation.

changed_reading.before: They are in front but remain part of an open contest.
changed_reading.after: They are the outstrippers whose lead has become non-recoverable: advance repeated as accomplished escape.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus repeats س ب ق, whose inventory includes both racing and the stake named for a race.
baseline_models.mechanism: B002 makes precedence triangular rather than merely ordinal: competitors move, something is at stake, and precedence adjudicates who receives it.

activation_trace.role: Competition supplies the moving contestants and their ordering.
The race-stake supplies consequence and lets the second occurrence sound like an adjudicated outcome, though the nominal branch is form-distant.

changed_reading.before: Precedence is a bare position on a timeline.
changed_reading.after: Precedence belongs to a consequential contest in which initiative determines an outcome with something genuinely at stake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event destroys ordinary vertical and terrestrial rankings, then sorts people into kinds; precedence becomes an order disclosed by upheaval rather than speed measured on stable ground.

activation_trace.role: Advancing and racing provide the focus's initial linear ordering.
A severe descending event supplies the crisis in which the focus ranking is revealed.
Lowering what was high destabilizes inherited rank.
Raising supplies the inverse motion and makes the event a wholesale reorder.
Kinds or classes convert the preceding physical inversion into a disclosed human classification.

structural_cues: 56:3 lowers and raises, 56:4-6 removes stable earth and mountain scale, and 56:7 then makes the addressees three classes before the focus label appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collapse, vertical reversal, and subsequent classification; I infer that the catastrophe reveals the criterion of precedence. A live alternative is that these are adjacent fixed groups with no causal relation to the upheaval.

changed_reading.before: The foremost win a race conducted within the world's existing order.
changed_reading.after: The foremost are the order that becomes visible when the world's normal measures of height, solidity, and status are overturned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two side-groups are defined by companionship with directions, but the focus group is defined by an act; its active advance is immediately answered by passive bestowal of privileged nearness.

activation_trace.role: Initiative and forward movement make this group agentive rather than merely locative.
Companionship and adherence define the neighboring group through affiliation.
The right hand or rightward side supplies one external directional classification.
The left side supplies the opposed external directional classification.
Favored intimates of a sovereign give the passive nearness its social force as bestowed access.

structural_cues: 56:8-9 repeat أصحاب plus a side-label, 56:10 instead repeats the bare active participle, and 56:11 identifies that group with a passive participle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directional affiliation, active precedence, and bestowed nearness; I infer an answer relation in which initiative is met by admission to proximity. Alternatively, 56:11 may only rename the group without explaining its precedence.

changed_reading.before: The foremost are self-advancing winners who secure the highest place.
changed_reading.after: They initiate movement but do not manufacture the endpoint: their precedence is answered by being made privileged intimates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's doubled agent can be distributed across time: a gathered vanguard at the beginning is followed by a thinner later continuation, so precedence is repeatedly instantiated rather than exhausted by one cohort.

activation_trace.role: Repeated advance supplies the relay-like action that can recur across cohorts.
A gathered company turns precedence from an isolated winner into a cohort phenomenon.
Beginning and temporal advance locate the abundant cohort at the head of the sequence.
The split root's image of one thing following another supplies continuity from one vanguard to the next.
Numerical smallness narrows, but does not erase, the relay's later continuation.
Laterness supplies the second temporal station against which repeated precedence is measured.

structural_cues: The singular sequence 56:13-14 contrasts a company from the first with a few from the later immediately after identifying the foremost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grouped first people, fewer later people, and both beginning and succession images for ء و ل; I infer that the focus repetition can span cohorts. Alternatively, the verses may report only proportions, leaving the repetition purely emphatic.

changed_reading.before: Precedence is a single synchronic ranking among contemporaries.
changed_reading.after: Precedence is a diachronic relay: abundant at the beginning, sparsely but genuinely re-instantiated later.

context_deltas.mechanism: A linear race with front and back resolves into an interwoven environment of mutual facing and circulation; precedence grants entry without reproducing winner-ahead-of-loser as the final social geometry.

activation_trace.role: Racing and forward advance supply the initial linear geometry.
Tight interweaving supplies the material setting in which separate linear tracks give way to connected placement.
Thing facing thing makes mutual presence, rather than one-way precedence, the group's settled posture.
Circulation around the group replaces a finish-line axis with an encompassing service motion.

structural_cues: 56:15-17 moves from woven couches to reciprocal facing and then to attendants circulating around the seated group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interweaving, face-to-face posture, and circulation; I infer that this endpoint transforms the race's geometry from line to mutual field. Alternatively, these may be amenities that leave rank fully intact.

changed_reading.before: The winner remains permanently in front of others.
changed_reading.after: The forerunner crosses into a shared space without front or back, where mutual facing replaces competitive posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The form-distant race-stake branch gains local structure: chosen and desired goods culminate in recompense corresponding to deliberate action, so the contest's consequence is earned reciprocity rather than an arbitrary wager.

activation_trace.role: The stake placed for a race supplies the exploratory consequence awaiting adjudication.
Seeking and making a choice turns the outcome into exercised agency rather than passive possession.
The soul's movement toward what it desires makes the awarded good responsive to the recipient.
Answering an act with its recompense converts the race-stake into measured reciprocity.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which the recompense corresponds.

structural_cues: 56:20-21 repeats مما with choosing and desiring, while 56:24 closes the provision sequence as recompense for what they used to do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, desire, recompense, and intentional work; I infer that they clarify the focus root's race-stake branch as earned and responsive. Alternatively, the reward sequence need not activate that form-distant branch at all.

changed_reading.before: The foremost merely arrive before others and receive a generic prize.
changed_reading.after: Their race has a morally structured stake: initiative culminates in action-matched recompense experienced as restored choice and fulfilled desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's doubled name is echoed by doubled peace after empty and injurious speech is excluded; repetition shifts from possible redundancy to a pure reciprocal recognition that already speaks the destination's language.

activation_trace.role: Repeated precedence supplies the compact identity formula whose discourse value is being revised.
Speech discarded as carrying no account marks the kind of empty repetition excluded from the endpoint.
Loading another with fault excludes accusatory speech and sharpens the harmlessness of the final echo.
Articulated utterance establishes that the doubled closing noun is an enacted speech exchange.
Freedom from harm gives the repeated utterance substantive safety rather than empty emphasis.

structural_cues: The doubled nominal focus formula in 56:10 is answered at the pericope's end by the doubled nominal utterance سلاما سلاما in 56:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two doubled formulas and an explicit purge of empty or blaming speech; I infer that the closing speech teaches how to hear the focus repetition as recognition. A live alternative is formal coincidence with ordinary emphatic repetition.

changed_reading.before: The second السابقون merely intensifies the first.
changed_reading.after: The doubled title acts like a reciprocal acclamation: a non-empty recognition of identity that anticipates the repeated language of safety.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because B003 names the leg-jesses of a hunting bird while the focus forms are active participles, and 56:21 names bird as food rather than a racer. It remains packet-anchored through the focus root inventory and the local bird root; render only as a counter-image in which competition marks or constrains its agents, never as a translation of السابقون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: B003 is an attested branch under the root repeated in both focus words.

activation_trace.role: A hunting bird's leg-jesses supply the root-internal counter-image of a moving agent marked and constrained by the apparatus around its movement.
The explicit bird domain and its light flight keep the obscure focus branch faintly active within the local sequence.

changed_reading.before: The foremost are imagined only as freely moving agents.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, precedence carries the shadow of the bird's jesses: a race can mark and constrain the very agents whose movement it ranks.

strongest_changes: Upheaval changes precedence from speed on stable ground into the human order disclosed when ordinary measures collapse.
Active initiative is answered, rather than self-completed, by passive admission to privileged nearness.
The linear race resolves into mutual facing and circulation instead of preserving front-versus-back as the final social geometry.
The closing doubled peace recasts the focus repetition as substantive recognition rather than empty emphasis.
summary.what_was_special: The same doubled root sustained initiative, uncatchability, and a consequential contest, while context changed its agency, temporal scale, spatial geometry, and speech value without forcing those readings into one.
remaining_uncertainties: The wager/stake branch is morphologically distant from the active participles and remains exploratory even after the reward sequence.
The diachronic relay depends on reading the first/later distribution back into the focus repetition.
The line-to-circle transformation and bird-jesses counter-image may be local resonances rather than intended lexical activations.
